## Reserve-track requests retained from the earlier audit

The archived eight-idea SOURCE-ACCESS.md has the precise records and earlier retrieval attempts for Porat and Stein on evidential damage; Plunkett and Sundell on normative disagreement; DeMott on fiduciary agency; Pettit on contestatory democracy; Bayamlıoğlu on contesting automated decisions; and Santos Campos on generational sovereignty. Neither entire book has been reviewed in this pass. Do not interpret an earlier obtained draft or excerpt as a full-book reading.
